about.title: About isshoni
about.lead: Watch your friends' screens together, on a server one of you runs.

trust.heading: Privacy and trust
trust.server: The server is trusted. Video and sound are encrypted on the way, but the server passes them on, so whoever runs it could see the streams.
trust.noRecording: There is no recording, and there are no hidden viewers: an admin who watches shows up in the viewer list like everyone else.
trust.stored: The server stores usernames and password hashes, your sign-ins with their last-seen time and IP address, invites, rooms, notification subscriptions, and a log of logins and admin actions that is pruned after 30 days.
trust.local: Window titles never leave your device. Friends see a share as a screen, a window or a tab.
trust.noTelemetry: No telemetry: the server reports nothing about you or itself to the isshoni project. The privacy page lists every connection the server makes.
